title: Properness transfers to uniformly close continuous maps and to their affine homotopy on the cylinder (supplied fact (P))
statement: Notation: ℝ^p := Eucl p. A map g : ℝ^m → ℝ^{m′} is proper on F ⊆ ℝ^m if g⁻¹(K) ∩ F is compact for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^{m′}. For y ∈ ℝ^{m+1} let t(y) := EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m+1)) ℝ y 0 and tl(y) := (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m+1)) ℝ y)), and for F ⊆ ℝ^m let cyl(F) := {y ∈ ℝ^{m+1} : t(y) ∈ [0,1] and tl(y) ∈ F}. (a) For all m, m′ ∈ ℕ, maps G, g : ℝ^m → ℝ^{m′}, every closed F ⊆ ℝ^m and every d ∈ ℝ: if g is continuous, G is proper on F and dist(g(x), G(x)) ≤ d for every x ∈ F, then g is proper on F. (b) For all m, m′ ∈ ℕ, maps G, F₀, F₁ : ℝ^m → ℝ^{m′}, every closed F ⊆ ℝ^m and every d ∈ ℝ: if F₀ and F₁ are continuous, G is proper on F, and dist(F₀(x), G(x)) ≤ d and dist(F₁(x), G(x)) ≤ d for every x ∈ F, then the affine homotopy H : ℝ^{m+1} → ℝ^{m′}, H(y) := F₀(tl(y)) + t(y)·(F₁(tl(y)) − F₀(tl(y))), is proper on cyl(F). (G itself need not be continuous.)
lean_statement: (∀ (m m' : ℕ) (G g : Eucl m → Eucl m') (F : Set (Eucl m)) (d : ℝ), IsClosed F → Continuous g → (∀ K : Set (Eucl m'), IsCompact K → IsCompact (G ⁻¹' K ∩ F)) → (∀ x ∈ F, dist (g x) (G x) ≤ d) → ∀ K : Set (Eucl m'), IsCompact K → IsCompact (g ⁻¹' K ∩ F)) ∧ (∀ (m m' : ℕ) (G F₀ F₁ : Eucl m → Eucl m') (F : Set (Eucl m)) (d : ℝ), IsClosed F → Continuous F₀ → Continuous F₁ → (∀ K : Set (Eucl m'), IsCompact K → IsCompact (G ⁻¹' K ∩ F)) → (∀ x ∈ F, dist (F₀ x) (G x) ≤ d) → (∀ x ∈ F, dist (F₁ x) (G x) ≤ d) → ∀ K : Set (Eucl m'), IsCompact K → IsCompact ((fun y : Eucl (m + 1) => F₀ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ y))) + (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ y 0) • (F₁ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ y))) - F₀ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ y))))) ⁻¹' K ∩ {y : Eucl (m + 1) | EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ y 0 ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ y)) ∈ F}))
